blocks.prompt: 14. In an integrated circuit with an initial current of 1080 mA, the temperature in the ... [the rest of the question is not printed in the book]
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal ki sirf pehli line kitab mein chhapi hai; baqi safha khaali hai.
Humein sirf shuru ka current (1080 mA) pata hai. Current kis tarah badalta hai (fixed miqdaar se ya fixed percentage se), kitne qadam hain, aur aakhir mein poocha kya gaya hai, yeh sab missing hai.
Is liye yeh sawal kitab se hal nahi ho sakta. Hum apni taraf se data nahi gharenge, kyunke ghara hua data kitab ka sawal nahi hota aur us se nikla jawab bhi kitab ke sawal ka jawab nahi kehlata.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: shuru ka current 1080 mA (baqi sawal chhapa nahi).
Humein find karna hai: kitab mein likha hi nahi.
Tareeqa: koi tareeqa chuna nahi ja sakta, kyunke current badalne ka qaida missing hai.

Kya chhapa hai
\[a_1 = 1080 \text{ mA}\]
Kyun: Kitab mein sirf itna hai: ek integrated circuit, shuru ka current 1080 mA, aur "the temperature in the". Jumla yahin ruk jata hai. Shuru ka current sequence ka pehla term ban sakta hai, lekin aage kuch maloom nahi.

Kya missing hai
Kyun: Sequence banane ke liye teen cheezein chahiye: current kis tarah badalta hai (har qadam fixed miqdaar se, to A.P.; ya fixed percentage se, to G.P.), woh tabdeeli kitni hai, aur kitne qadam ke baad ka current poocha gaya hai. In mein se kuch bhi chhapa nahi. Andaze se data rakhna asal sawal hal karna nahi hoga, is liye hum yeh nahi karte.

Answer key kya deti hai
\[410.4 \text{ mA}\]
Kyun: Answer key mein 410.4 mA likha hai. Hum is ki tasdeeq nahi kar sakte, kyunke jis data se yeh jawab nikalta hai woh kitab mein mojood nahi. Itna zaroor nazar aata hai ke jawab 1080 se kam hai, yani current ghat raha hai; lekin kis qaide se ghata, yeh chhape hue hisse se maloom nahi ho sakta. Mukammal sawal apne teacher se le lein; phir A.P. ya G.P. ka qaida wahi lagega jo is exercise ke baqi sawalon mein laga.
blocks.final_answer: Kitab se hal nahi ho sakta: sawal adhoora hai. Answer key mein 410.4 mA likha hai.

blocks.title: Kitab mein missing
blocks.text: Sawal 14 kitab ke safha 122 par adhoore jumle par ruk jata hai aur baqi safha khaali hai, is liye data aur asal sawal dono missing hain. Answer key ka 410.4 mA chhape hue text se check nahi ho sakta. Hum missing hissa apni taraf se nahi banate. Exam ki tayyari ke liye is exercise ke baqi sawal hal karein; un mein A.P. aur G.P. dono qism ke "real life" sawal mojood hain.
